g.text: LightGBM (red) vs N-HiTS Huber (blue), forecast from each origin.

text.style: fill: #111111; font: 700 13px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Where LightGBM wins on WMAPE: FOODS_1

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Shaded = gap between LightGBM and N-HiTS Huber. Dotted lines = forecast origins. WMAPE = sum of absolute errors / sum of actual sales; |bias| = |total forecast / total actual - 1|.

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Example chosen by rule: largest WMAPE advantage (points on the series) of LightGBM over N-HiTS Huber in the segment, among series selling at least the median

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: weekly volume in history, with no run of 4+ zero weeks and no week under 10% of the series' median weekly sales (history or forecast weeks), at least 52 weeks

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: of history, and forecast-week sales within 0.67-1.5x the history level (no level shift).

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: FOODS_1_046_CA_1 is rank 1 of 140 candidates. 1,257 of 2,160 series in the segment (58%) have the lower error with LightGBM.

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Of the 2,019 series with >50 units: 11 improved with N-HiTS Huber by >20% of their error, 50 got worse by as much.
